final: WITH per_telescope AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS overall_avg FROM per_telescope), above_overall AS (SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_pulse, p.avg_pulse - o.overall_avg AS excess FROM per_telescope p JOIN overall o ON p.avg_pulse > o.overall_avg), mean_excess AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean_pulse FROM above_overall), above_mean AS (SELECT a.telescref, a.avg_pulse, a.excess, a.avg_pulse - m.mean_pulse AS margin FROM above_overall a JOIN mean_excess m ON a.avg_pulse > m.mean_pulse) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse), AVG(excess), AVG(margin) FROM above_mean
